meaning:
Ἄρειος Πάυος (T, Ἄριος Π.), -ου, ὁ
Hill of Pres or Mars, Areopagus; also, the Court of Areopagus, the highest tribunal of Athens: Act.17:19, 22.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?
